content: Isra7eele asaa booray woykko dorsi dhaydi wora bishin intte demmiko co7u gi aadhdhofte; iza godaas laagga efa imma.
Gido attiin mehaaddey dizasoy haaho gidikko woykko he mehaaddey oonakko ne erontta aggiko meheza neso ekkada ba; mehaaddey koyishe yiikko izayssa izas zaara.
May7o gidiin woykko hare gidiin woykko hara ay miishshika ne bagga Isra7eele asaappe dhayiin ne demmidaa gidikko zaarada izaades imma.
Ne bagga Isra7eele asaas harey woykko booray ogen kundiin ne be7idaa gidikko maaddada denththa attiin be7ashe yegga aadhdhofa.
GODAA intte Xoossay hessaththo ooththizayta ixxiza gishshas maccati attumasata may7o, attumasati maccassata may7o may7ofetto.
Ne oge bishin kafoy ba keeththan miththa bolla woykko biitta bolla yelida ciyeta woykko phuuphphulle haphpha diza kafo ne demmidaa kafoyo ciyetara gaththa neso efoppa.
Ciyeta neso ekka baanaas dandayaasa; aayeyo gidikko iza piradhdha baana mala yedda; neni hessaththo ooththiko nees lo7o gidananne ne daro layth daana.
Ne ooraththa keeth keexxashe he keeththaa kaarappe asi kundidi suuththa acon nena oyshisontta mala keeththaa kaara bolla teqe woththa.
Neni woyne mith tokkashe iza giddon hara zereth zeroppa; ne hara zerikko woyne miththaa ayfeppe gidiin woykko hara ne zeroo kaththaafe go7ettanaas dandayakka.
Booranne hare issife issi qambaran waaxa goyoppa.
Suufeppenne puuttofe walaketti dadettida may7o may7ofa.
Ne may7ana may7os oyddu baggarakka macara medhdha.
Geela7oteththas Imettida Woga Naago
Issi asi machcho ekkida mala izira aqi simmidi izo ixxiko,
«Hanno maccassayo ekkadis shin izis geela7oteththa wogay baawa» giidi wordora izi sunththu moorikko,
he nayo yelidayti naya geela7o gididayssas markka ehidi he katamaan diza cimata bessetto.
Nay aaway isttas, «Tani ta nayo hayssa addezas immadis shin ha7i izi izo ixxidayssa qonccisides.

‹Ne nays geela7oteththi baawa› giidi ta nay sunththu moorides; ta nays geela7oteththi dizayssas hayssi markka» giidi he dere kaaleththizayta sinththan izi izo ekkishin may7o bolla gukkida suuththara diza malata carqqaza besso.
He katamayo kaaleththizayti addeza shoci qaxxayetto.

Qasseka izi Isra7eele naytappe geela7oteththara diza issiney sunththu moorida gishshas issi xeetu saqile bira nay aawaas magaco qanxxo; hessafe guye nayakka izas machcho gidu; izi shemppora paxa diza layth ubbaan izo anjji yeddanaas dandayenna.
Gido attiin izi gidayssi tumu gidi beettiko qasse iza geela7o gididayssa qonccisiza malatay baynda aggiko,

iza ba aawa soon dashe laymatada Isra7eele asaa yeellachchiza ooso ooththida gishshas izo izi aawa keeththa kare efetto; he katamaan diza asay izo shuchchara caddi wodho; hessaththo histtidi intte giddofe iita miish diggite.
Issi asi hara asa machchira zin7i beettiko nam7ayka hayqqetto; hessaththo histtidi intte giddofe iita miish diggite.
Ay asikka katama giddon azina gelana giiga uttida geela7oyra zin7idi beettiko,

nam7atakka he katamayppe kare kessidi shuchchan caddi wodhite; geela7oya katama giddon dashe, «Tana ashshite» gaada waassontta gishshas hayqqanaas bessees; qasse addezi hara asara giiga dizaarira zin7idi woga menththida gishshas hayqqanaas bessees; hessaththo histtidi intte giddofe iita miish diggite.
Issi asi hara asas giiga uttida geela7oyo iza diza katamappe harason demmi wolqqaththidi izi geela7oteththaa ekkidaa gidikko hessaadey xalla hayqqo.
Naya hayqos gaththiza nagara ooththontta gishshas izo bochchofte; hayssa mala oosoy issi asi genera ba laggeza shemppo wodhizayssara issi gina.
Hessika he addezi hara asas giigetta uttida geela7oya ba diza katamappe karen dishin demmidi izo oykkida gishshassinne iza waassidaakkoka izo ashshana asi baynda gishshassa.
Ay asikka hara asara giigettontta geela7oyra zin7ishe oykettiko,
nay aawaas ichchash tammu saqile bira qanxxidi izo baas machcho histto; wolqqan izira zin7ida gishshas hayqqana gakkanaaska izo anjji yeddanaas dandayenna.
Oonikka ba aawa machcho ekkidi woykko izira zin7idi ba aawa yeellasoppo.

footnotes.text: Keeththaa kaara bolla teqe woththa gizayssi Isra7eele biittan keeth keexxishe keeththaa kaaray bollan demba gidida gishshas asi bollafe kundontta mala gaxara teqe woththeettes.
